MACHINE EVOLVED - COMPLETE TEXT MOVEMENT DOSSIER
=================================================

PURPOSE
This is a machine-readable and human-readable account of one full movement
episode for the selected creature. It includes every recorded
20 Hz pose; no frames are omitted. It is intended to let an external model
inspect the gait numerically without watching the Three.js preview.

IDENTITY AND INTEGRITY

Replay SHA-256: f0bdfdb84453ea7da0d5dd71228cb28f1ea9119f2858869a5dd1eb97474650a6
Schema: machine-evolved-capsules-v1 v1
Profile: overnight-confirm2-R5-240907
Creature ID: machine-evolved-three-capsule-v1
Samples: 1201 at 20 Hz over 60 seconds
Configured fitness: 2940.100340 source simulation-units
Replayed fitness: 2940.100340 source simulation-units
Fitness parity verified: true

UNITS AND COORDINATES
Source: z up; horizontal x,y; units simulation-units.
Table: y up; horizontal x,z; replay displayScale=0.01.
The replay metadata labels scaled coordinates as metres. There is no separate
empirical calibration establishing SI metres, so this dossier calls them
display units (DU). Conversion: 1 source simulation-unit = 0.01 DU.

CREATURE
Three serially connected capsules. Table aliases c0, c1, c2 are in this order:
c0: id=m1-balanced-capsule-0; innerHeight=0.760000000 DU (76.000000000 source units); radius=0.140000000 DU (14.000000000 source units)
c1: id=m1-balanced-capsule-1; innerHeight=0.760000000 DU (76.000000000 source units); radius=0.140000000 DU (14.000000000 source units)
c2: id=m1-balanced-capsule-2; innerHeight=0.760000000 DU (76.000000000 source units); radius=0.140000000 DU (14.000000000 source units)
Connectivity: c1 is jointed to c0; c2 is jointed to c1.

INTERPRETATION FOR REVIEW
This dossier deliberately reports measurements and the complete pose trace without
classifying the gait as desirable locomotion or a reward exploit. Pair it with the
candidate's separately versioned motion-analysis JSON for thresholded credibility,
rolling-signature, and final-progress decisions. This keeps a dossier reusable for
any selected controller instead of inheriting conclusions from an earlier champion.
